goal: FG-403: Target check is the design check and target promote the one full check

components.summary: Holds one target and checks its design, the merged code and tests.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target at a time A replaced component can migrate its fingerprint formula when promoted. A refused promotion prints its complete report from the single check without modifying project bytes.
check the merged tree: design mistakes are ERROR, missing code is TO-DO
mark only the breakage of a changed subject as moving to target
refuse a target that changes nothing, drops a promise or leaves it untied
promote a clean target and leave changed components draft
warn about earlier findings, stale debts and untested rules without blocking
list what to re-read after promotion and which files to delete
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check

components.summary: Owns map schema, component sub-systems, model bindings and direct component fingerprints.
responsibilities: load, validate and save the map, pointing a missing map at the guide Keep version-only changes neutral in format 2 fingerprints and migrate legacy component pointers once. Memoize parsed contracts by absolute path and exact byte digest, returning detached copies; never store proof results.
resolve component parents in one layer without loops
merge the target overlay, validate its remove intents and compare it with current
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions
register contract models and build the model tree with its nesting errors
count import-like strings and injected attribute calls as dependency evidence
name every removed path, literal, flag and public name in one table
